definitions.explanation: the price at which something is sold to customers

examples.japanese: {売値|うりね}は{千|せん}{円|えん}です。
{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}と{売値|うりね}の{差|さ}が{利益|りえき}になる。
examples.english: The difference between the purchase price and selling price becomes profit.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}の{売値|うりね}を{下|さ}げないと{売|う}れないかもしれない。
examples.english: We might not sell this product unless we lower the selling price.

notes:
{売値|うりね} is a business term for the selling price or retail price of a product.

WRITING:
- {売|う}り (selling)
- {値|ね} (price, value)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売値|うりね}を{付|つ}ける (to set a selling price)
- {売値|うりね}を{下|さ}げる (to lower the selling price)
- {売値|うりね}を{決|き}める (to determine the selling price)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {買値|かいね} (purchase price, buying price)

RELATED WORDS:
- {仕入|しい}れ{値|ね} (wholesale/purchase price)
- {定価|ていか} (list price)
- {原価|げんか} (cost price)
- {小売|こうり}{価格|かかく} (retail price - more formal)
